name: Jaipur The Rose
poem: Conceived by a Maharaja's dream of hospitality, each facade captures the morning's first light. A metropolis not merely constructed, but brought to life with a blush.

landmarks.name: Hawa Mahal
landmarks.description: It is not a palace, but a veil. A thousand apertures for a thousand gazes to observe the world, themselves unobserved. A partition of breeze and rock.

landmarks.name: Amber Fort
landmarks.description: A formidable citadel-palace of ruddy sandstone and ivory marble, a monument to Rajput magnificence.

landmarks.name: City Palace
landmarks.description: An expansive labyrinth of plazas, gardens, and structures, the vibrant core of the ancient city.

name: Jodhpur The Indigo
poem: An ocean of blue, flowing down the stone from the base of Mehrangarh. A hue to temper the heat, a sanctuary for the heavens.

landmarks.name: Mehrangarh Fort
landmarks.description: It does not ascend. It emerges from the stone, a continuation of the land, erected by titans and polished by the sun.

landmarks.name: Jaswant Thada
landmarks.description: A tranquil marble memorial, a tribute to Maharaja Jaswant Singh II.

landmarks.name: Umaid Bhawan Palace
landmarks.description: A splendid palace, serving as a hotel, museum, and royal home.

name: Jaisalmer The Golden
poem: An illusion brought to life. A fortress of sand engineered to endure millennia, radiant with the stored brilliance of a desert midday.

landmarks.name: The Living Fort
landmarks.description: Inside these gilded ramparts, existence persists as it has for centuries. Markets, residences, and shrines resonate with a serene, enduring vitality.

landmarks.name: Patwon Ki Haveli
landmarks.description: A collection of five mansions, a marvel of detailed craftsmanship.

landmarks.name: Sam Sand Dunes
landmarks.description: Feel the enchantment of the wilderness with a camel trek on the gilded sands.

name: Udaipur The White
poem: A metropolis of alabaster and liquid, where castles appear to levitate on the water's expanse. A vision mirrored in the tranquility of Pichola.

landmarks.name: Lake Pichola
landmarks.description: The soul of Udaipur. In daylight, it reflects the sun; at night, it becomes a tapestry for the constellations and illuminated castles.

landmarks.name: City Palace of Udaipur
landmarks.description: A grand palace labyrinth, a fusion of Rajasthani and Mughal designs.

landmarks.name: Jag Mandir
landmarks.description: A castle erected on an isle in Lake Pichola, a sanctuary of serene elegance.

name: The Thar The Silence
poem: The immense void, where the terrain is shaped solely by the breeze. Here, the skyline is the solitary goal, and the quietude is the most resonant noise.

landmarks.name: The Dunes
landmarks.description: A sea of sand, perpetually shifting, eternally calm. To observe the sunrise here is to behold the planet's creation.

landmarks.name: Desert National Park
landmarks.description: A broad region of sand and stone, supporting a distinctive ecosystem.

landmarks.name: Khuri Village
landmarks.description: Immerse yourself in the customary way of life of the desert inhabitants in this quaint hamlet.

name: Pushkar The Divine
poem: A hallowed village on the banks of a sacred lake, a site of devotion and belief.

landmarks.name: Pushkar Lake
landmarks.description: A consecrated lake encircled by 52 bathing spots, where devotees arrive to cleanse and worship.

landmarks.name: Brahma Temple
landmarks.description: Among the rare shrines globally devoted to Lord Brahma, the originator.

landmarks.name: Savitri Temple
landmarks.description: A shrine for Brahma's spouse, providing sweeping vistas of the village.
